title: Intolerable Risk Threshold Recommendations for Artificial Intelligence: Key Principles, Considerations, and Case Studies to Inform Frontier AI Safety Frameworks for Industry and Government

bias_targets.methodology: Recommends evaluating discrimination through regular algorithmic audits that compare outcome rates (using disparity ratios) across different demographic groups to identify intersectional harms, alongside composite fairness metrics that measure embedded space analysis and word association bias.

Evaluates the systemic vulnerability and disparate economic impacts of AI adoption, specifically analyzing how widespread automation may disproportionately displace jobs and impoverish specific regions or populations without adequate socioeconomic safeguards.
